proposals.evidence: Turner’s kalya dawn branch explicitly includes Punjabi/Lahnda kallh, eastern kāil/kālh, Assamese/Oriya kāli and Hindi kal for yesterday/tomorrow. These simple survey time words fit that family, including local locative/dative endings -ke/-ku; the survey tomorrow sense is preserved. Responses containing coming or next are excluded.
